# vcp_llm_access_key (Resource)

Manages an access key of an LLM group. The key calls the models of its group at the inference address of each model (`vcp_llm_models`).

~> The API hands the secret out once. The provider takes it right after issuing the key and keeps it in the state only: protect the state. An imported key, or one whose secret could not be taken after the issue, has no `secret`, and the only way to get one is to replace the key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vcp_llm_access_key" "api" {
  group_id = vcp_llm_group.backend.id
  name     = "api"
  tags     = ["production"]
}

# A key kept, but refused by the models until it is unlocked.
resource "vcp_llm_access_key" "reserve" {
  group_id    = vcp_llm_group.backend.id
  name        = "reserve"
  locked      = true
  lock_reason = "Issued for the failover; unlock when switching over."
}

output "api_key_secret" {
  value     = vcp_llm_access_key.api.secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (Number) ID of the group (`vcp_llm_group`) the key belongs to. Changing it deletes the key and issues a new one, with a new secret.
- `name` (String) Key name. Changing it deletes the key and issues a new one, with a new secret.

### Optional

- `lock_reason` (String) Reason of the lock, for the people reading the panel. Only with `locked = true`. Changing it on a locked key unlocks the key and locks it again with the new reason.
- `locked` (Boolean) Whether the key is locked by the project. A locked key is refused by the models until it is unlocked. Locks by quota, by the administrator, by the balance and by the platform are not managed here.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags of the key. The set is applied whole; omitting it or an empty set removes every tag.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Access key ID.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Secret of the key, for the `Authorization` header of the inference calls. Set when the key is issued; empty for an imported key.
- `state` (String) Key state: `active`, `revoking`, `revoked` or `removing`. A key of a disabled group is revoked. New states may be added over time.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Access keys are imported as <group_id>/<access_key_id>. The secret is not
# imported: the API hands it out once, when the key is issued.
terraform import vcp_llm_access_key.api 42/1001
```
